meta.title: 12 Monkeys
sources: collated dates 2026-09-08: airport/release Dec 13 1996 (film line 'probably on December 13, 1996'); future = 2035 (film); 1990 stay year-only

worlds.label: Single plague timeline
worlds.description: Closed loop; mission fulfills the past it sought to study

events.label: Virus released 1996-12-13 in Philadelphia; 99% of humanity dies
events.description: A scientist's engineered virus wipes out almost everyone on Earth. The few survivors live underground for decades.

events.label: 2035: Cole sent to gather virus info
events.description: The underground scientists pick a prisoner, James Cole, and send him back in time. He is told to find where the virus came from - not to stop it.

events.label: Cole arrives wrong year 1990; institutionalized
events.description: The time machine misses its target by six years and drops Cole into 1990. The police think he is insane and lock him in a psychiatric hospital.

events.label: Cole returns to 1996 with Railly
events.description: Sent back again, Cole lands in the right year. He picks up the psychiatrist who has come to believe him, and together they hunt for the virus.

events.label: Army of the Twelve Monkeys is animal-release red herring
events.description: The trail points to a group called the Army of the Twelve Monkeys - but all they did was free the animals from the zoo. They had nothing to do with the virus.

events.label: Airport: true bio-terrorist boards; Cole shot
events.description: At the airport Cole finally spots the real carrier, a quiet scientist named Dr. Peters. Cole tries to stop him and the police shoot Cole dead.

events.label: Cole dies; boy Cole witnesses
events.description: As a small boy, Cole stood in that airport and watched a man being shot. The man was his older self.

events.label: Cole's lifelong dream = his own death
events.description: All his life Cole has been haunted by a dream of an airport shooting. It is not a dream - it is the memory of watching his own death.

events.label: Jose present with future instructions
events.description: Another traveler from the future, Jose, finds Cole at the airport and hands him a gun.

events.label: Mission was always part of the plague history
events.description: Nothing is changed. The mission, Cole's death, the boy watching - it was all part of history from the start.

events.label: Cole misjumps to asylum 1990
events.description: Cole is thrown back to 1990 by mistake and ends up inside the asylum.

events.label: Army of Twelve Monkeys zoo release
events.description: The Army of the Twelve Monkeys turns out to be animal-rights protesters who freed the zoo. Not the virus.

events.label: Airport death = childhood memory
events.description: The airport shooting is the exact scene young Cole witnessed - his recurring dream is his own death.

events.label: Sent from future to find virus origin
events.description: The scientists send Cole back in time to trace the virus to its source.

events.label: 1990 asylum (months; month not stated); meets Railly and Goines
events.description: Locked up in 1990, Cole meets two people who will shape everything: his future psychiatrist Kathryn Railly, and a wild patient named Jeffrey Goines.

events.label: Army of the Twelve Monkeys red herring
events.description: Cole and Railly chase the Army of the Twelve Monkeys, convinced it released the virus.

events.label: Dream was witnessing own death
events.description: Cole works out that the dream he has had since childhood is the memory of watching himself die.

events.label: True virus releaser boards plane
events.description: The true carrier, Dr. Peters, calmly boards his flight carrying the virus. Nothing can stop him now.

events.label: Future underground survivors hierarchy
events.description: Decades after the plague, what is left of humanity lives in grim underground colonies run by scientists.

events.label: Railly becomes believer
events.description: A bullet decades older than it should be convinces Railly that Cole really is a traveler from the future.

events.label: Jeffrey Goines / animal rights misdirection
events.description: Everyone, including Cole, assumes the madman Jeffrey Goines unleashed the virus. He did not.

events.label: Scientist voices / mission briefing loops
events.description: Cole keeps hearing recorded voices from the scientists - including a message Railly left in 1996, played back to him in the future.

events.label: Dr. Peters releases the virus in Philadelphia
events.description: Dr. Peters walks through the airport with the virus and lets it loose. The end of the world is one man boarding a plane.

payload.note: added 2026-09-08: film line - released in Philadelphia, probably on December 13, 1996; airport boarding scene

ruleEffects.effect: Attempt to stop apocalypse enacts the witnessed death that defined Cole

outcome.summary: Closed predestination loop: Cole dies as the boy who dreamed the death; plague origin not prevented.
